emailInput.description: email text field on the login and register forms

passwordInput.description: password field on the login and register forms

loginButton.description: button labelled 'Log in' that submits the login form

registerButton.description: button labelled 'Register' that submits the register form

message.description: status text shown after submitting ('Logged in', 'Invalid email or password', 'Account created', ...)

searchInput.description: search text box above the product list

searchButton.description: button labelled 'Search' that submits the search

resultCount.description: text '<n> products' giving the number of listed products

productCard.description: list item for one product; filter it by product name

productName.description: product name heading inside a product card

productPrice.description: price text like '$59.99' inside a product card

productStock.description: 'In stock' or 'Out of stock' inside a product card

addToCartButton.description: button labelled 'Add to Cart' that adds this card's product to the cart; disabled when out of stock

cartMessage.description: status text after adding, e.g. 'Added Wireless Headphones to cart'

cartCount.description: number of items in the cart shown in the nav bar

noResults.description: 'No products found' shown when a search matches nothing

cartItem.description: table row for one cart line; filter it by product name

itemName.description: product name in a cart row

itemPrice.description: line price like '$59.99' in a cart row

removeButton.description: button labelled 'Remove' in a cart row

emptyCart.description: 'Your cart is empty' message, visible only when the cart is empty

checkoutButton.description: button labelled 'Proceed to Checkout'; disabled when the cart is empty

placeOrderButton.description: button labelled 'Place Order'; on success navigates to the payment page

checkoutMessage.description: error text such as 'Your cart is empty' or 'Please fill in all shipping fields'

expiry.description: card expiry field in MM/YY format

payButton.description: button labelled 'Pay' that submits the payment
